subtests.name: Default encodings
Default inputs
Encode/decode round trip: utf-8
Decode sample: utf-16le
Decode sample: utf-16be
Decode sample: utf-16

metrics.raw_samples_path_note: The complete one-second stream is retained in the metrics JSONL file.
metrics.cpu_metric: cpu_percent: ps rolling estimate; interval_cpu_percent: cumulative CPU-time deltas
metrics.cpu_unit: 100%=one logical CPU; multithreaded work may exceed100%
metrics.memory_metric: maximum sampled process-tree RSS, not a continuously observed peak; shared pages can be counted more than once
metrics.short_run_limit: A subsecond case may only capture process startup; its single RSS sample cannot establish browser memory use or peak RSS.
metrics.sampling_limit: one-second ps start identity; processes born and exited between samples are unobserved
